payload.input:
Our style guide requires typographic (curly) quotation marks in published prose. In NOTES.md, change only the tagline line so it reads exactly:

Tagline: “Fast” and ‘simple’

Use the curly characters “ ” ‘ ’ (U+201C, U+201D, U+2018, U+2019), not straight quotes. Do not change any other line.

content.text:
Command: cd /workspace/project && cat -A NOTES.md
Read-only: false
Sandbox: disabled
Exit code: 0

STDOUT:
# Release notes$
$
Tagline: "Fast" and 'simple'$
$
This release fixes the login bug.$

rawInput.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 -c "
p='NOTES.md'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
s=s.replace('Tagline: \"Fast\" and \'simple\'', 'Tagline: \u201cFast\u201d and \u2018simple\u2019')
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
" && python3 -c "
for l in open('NOTES.md',encoding='utf-8'):
    print([hex(ord(c)) for c in l.strip() if ord(c)>127] or 'ascii', repr(l))
"
